title: skills(objectstack-data): `rules/field-types.md` says a formula's `returnType` has no `currency` member, which PR #22733 (#22727) widens
body:
Blocked-by: #22727

Filing gate **①**: a shipped-surface defect (North Star 4: `skills/**` ships to authors, and this text states a fact the platform contradicts). Its reach is a named producer, `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`, which an AI author reads and follows. The text becomes false when PR #22733 (#22727) lands: `FieldSchema.returnType` gains `'currency'`, and a currency formula carries its currency in its own `currencyConfig`, with the same schema a currency field uses.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `marchtian` · session `session_016njDy8ozy9B9Ns5Y8kAWEK`, at #22727's ACCEPT. ⛔ Not a claim. The edit is governed (`skills/**`, Tier H), so it belongs to the skills lane, with a maintainer's approval. It was deliberately kept out of PR #22733, so that the 772-line spec PR stays off governed paths and the maintainer reviews one small text change here instead.

**Acting reader:** the `domain:skills` seat (triage routes it). It acts once #22727 closes (PR #22733's `Fixes #22727`).

## What goes false (read on `origin/main` at filing)
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md:253`: `returnType: 'number',   // 'number' | 'text' | 'boolean' | 'date' (no 'currency')`. After #22733, `'currency'` is a member.
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md:129`: the `formula` row lists `returnType` as `'number' | 'text' | 'boolean' | 'date'`. After #22733 the member set is five, and a currency formula may carry `currencyConfig`.

## The replacement, as #22733 states it
- `'currency'` is a `returnType` member. A currency formula carries its currency in its own `currencyConfig` (`CurrencyConfigSchema`, the same as a currency field). When `currencyConfig` is absent, the mode is `dynamic`: the tenant default currency.
- `@objectstack/formula`'s `inferFormulaReturn(expression, fields)` returns the declaration to stamp: `{ returnType: 'currency' }`, plus `currencyConfig { fixed, defaultCurrency }` when every source amount shares one fixed currency. It returns `{ returnType: 'number' }` when two sources carry different fixed currencies.
- ⛔ Do not teach that a currency formula RENDERS as money yet. The renderer half is objectui#12111, which has not shipped.

## Done when
Both lines state the five-member set and the `currencyConfig` carrier. The skills lane's own checks (`check:skills-token-ratchet`, `check:skill-examples`) stay green.

Dedupe: an MCP `search_issues` on this repo, `skills objectstack-data field-types formula returnType currency skill text`, returned 15 hits, open and closed. None is this subject; the nearest is #20090 (closed), on the currency field's `dynamic` teaching. The open `domain:skills` cards (7) were also read by title: none is on `field-types.md`.
